facts.text: Serve the mains when Raya and her crew sit down to share the soup.
facts.why: The crew never sit down to share a soup. The shared meal in the film is Benja's plan to feed the five lands with ingredients from each, and Boun's congee is served on his boat.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Benja plans a meal to share with the five lands.

facts.why: Boun's boat is the Shrimporium and his special is shrimp congee, not prawn soup.

facts.text: Fresh prawn soup, one bowl each. Don't spill on the boat, and welcome aboard. Everybody eats here, even strangers.
facts.why: Not a film line. Boun's real pitch is about shrimp congee ('We got a shrimp congee that won't quit'), so a note about prawn soup does not match what he serves.
facts.fix: Shrimp congee, one bowl each. Don't spill on the boat, and welcome to the Shrimporium. Everybody eats here, even strangers.

fix_note.text: Shrimp congee, one bowl each. Don't spill on the boat, and welcome to the Shrimporium. Everybody eats here, even strangers.

facts.why: Benja is Raya's father, who hosts the feast. The congee is Boun's, served on his boat in Tail.
Nothing shows Noi swiping a papaya salad; what the film does say is that the ongis have nine stomachs and Boun promised them all the congee they could eat.
facts.fix: Bring extra, the ongis have nine stomachs.
facts.full: Little Noi swiped one on the way past.

vibe.verdict: A cheerful takeaway on a boat that gets Boun and the Ongis, but it misses the real soup scene and gets Benja and Boun mixed up.

Swap 'Benja's prawn congee' for 'Boun's prawn congee' and use his line about a shrimp congee that won't quit.
